title: Narrowing a timestamp cast truncates toward zero
verdict: toward zero below 1970, where the reference floors
description: A cast of `TIMESTAMP_NS` to `TIMESTAMP`, or of `TIMESTAMP` to `TIMESTAMP_MS` or `TIMESTAMP_S`, divides the count and truncates toward zero. Below 1970-01-01 the result is the later instant: 1969-12-31 23:59:59.999999999 becomes 1970-01-01 00:00:00.
reference: D61: a cast to a coarser precision floors on the timeline (`date_trunc`); from nanoseconds it is the floor of the count divided by 1000.
